Set up your voice → YOU Your Name Real Estate Agent EN Hi, this is your voice card greeting visitors who scan you. F.A.Q Frequently Asked Questions Is the digital business card free? Yes — our Digital QR Business Card is free forever with unlimited sharing and one-tap save to contacts. How do I share my digital business card? Share via QR code, short link or email. Recipients can save your contact with one tap. Do recipients need an app to save the card? No — recipients do not need an app. The card opens in the device browser and can be saved directly to contacts. Can I update my contact after sharing? Yes — updates are live. Anyone with your link or QR sees the latest information. Is it secure and private? Yes — we use HTTPS and follow standard security practices. You control what fields are public. What is a Digital business Card? A Digital business Card is a smart, shareable card that lets you connect, share contact details, or link to your business or profile instantly using a simple QR code. Is Digital QR Card a digital business card app? It is a digital business card you create and share from a web browser, so there is no app to download, for you or for the people you share with. Share it as a QR code or a link and anyone can save your contact with one tap. It is also known as a virtual business card or an electronic business card. How much does a digital business card cost? A card is free: the Free plan gives you 2 digital business cards with unlimited sharing. Pro Lifetime is a one-time payment, not a subscription, and team packs are also paid once, for 3, 5 or 10 people. The current prices are on the Pricing page. What is the difference between a digital business card and a paper business card? A paper card is printed once and goes out of date. A digital business card is a link and a QR code that always opens your latest details, saves to the other person's contacts in one tap and shows you how many times it was viewed or scanned. There is nothing to reprint when your job title or phone number changes. Can people save my digital business card as a vCard? Yes. The Download vCard button on your card downloads your details as a standard vCard file (.vcf) that phones and computers import into their contacts. Can I add my digital business card to Google Wallet or Apple Wallet? You can save your card to Google Wallet from your card page on Android. Apple Wallet is not offered yet. Can I use a QR code business card at events, conferences and trade shows? Yes. Put your QR code on a badge, a booth sign or a slide, and anyone who scans it opens your card. With lead capture on, the card asks for the details you choose, such as a name and an email, and your analytics show views and scans. Lead capture and contact export are on paid plans. What plans are available? Two: Free (2 cards, free forever) and Pro Lifetime, $45 once for up to 3 cards, lead capture, analytics and the voice agent. Teams can buy a 3, 5 or 10 seat pack, also paid once. How do I get Pro? Buy Pro Lifetime once for $45 from the Pricing page. Your account gets the Pro features right away, with no subscription to manage. Can I get a refund? Yes, within 14 days of your purchase. Contact support and we will refund you; your account then returns to the Free plan. Is payment secure? Absolutely. All payments are processed securely via Stripe, an industry-standard trusted payment provider. Is there a subscription to cancel? No. Pro is a single $45 payment with no renewals, so there is nothing to cancel. Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase. What languages are supported? DigitalQRCard is available in 13 languages: English, العربية, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, Русский, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, हिन्दी. Change the language with the selector in the header. Arabic uses a right-to-left layout. In which languages can my digital business card be written? You can write your digital business card in any of the supported locales: English (en), Arabic (ar), Spanish (es), French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Indonesian (id), Russian (ru), Chinese (zh), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Hindi (hi). Choose the language from the language selector when editing your card. Note: Arabic uses RTL layout when selected. What is the best digital business card platform with no monthly subscription? Digital QR Card has no monthly subscription. The Free plan gives you 2 digital cards with unlimited sharing. Pro is a one-time payment of $45 for lifetime access. Team packs are also one-time: $99 for 3 seats, $149 for 5 seats, or $249 for 10 seats, and every seat gets full Pro features. Nothing recurs to keep your card live. How do I create a digital QR code business card for sales teams and real estate agents? Create a free account and fill in your profile. Your card gets its own QR code and a shareable link. Print the QR code on paper materials, or send the link by text or email. For a sales team or brokerage group, buy a team pack, which gives up to 10 people Pro cards for one payment. Add each person from the Team page. How does the voice intro work, and what languages does it speak? The voice intro is Voice Agent. A visitor who scans your card can talk to an AI agent that speaks in a cloned version of your voice, built on ElevenLabs Conversational AI. The agent answers in the visitor's browser language. Voice Agent is a beta feature, so access is limited while it is in beta. Can I export lead capture data and analytics to CSV? You can export leads on a paid plan. The Contacts page lists every lead your card captured, and the CSV export downloads that full list. On the Free plan, Contacts shows an upgrade prompt instead. Card analytics such as views and clicks are shown in your dashboard.

Those are tap-to-share digital cards. Same mechanic as ours. The difference is the voice layer. Visitors scan your card, tap Talk to me, and have a real-time voice conversation with an AI agent trained on your profile, speaking in your actual cloned voice. None of them ship that today. Built on ElevenLabs Conversational AI. Do the people scanning need to install an app? No. They tap or scan with the camera on any phone — iPhone or Android — and your full profile opens instantly. They can save your contact, or tap Talk to me, in one motion. Is this really a one-time payment? Yes. $45 once. No subscription, no renewal, no hidden fees. Ever. 14-day money-back guarantee if you change your mind. What's the ElevenLabs partnership? ElevenLabs (the leading voice AI company) gave us a partnership grant to ship Voice Card, Voice Agent, and Voice Reply with a published case study. During the partnership, founding members get 300 minutes of Voice Agent conversations per month. What happens to my Voice Agent after the partnership ends? Your agent stays live. Founding members keep 30 minutes per month included, on a fair-use basis. Extra minutes are paid at $0.20/min from prepaid $5 packs (25 min/pack, never expire). Most cardholders never come near 30 min/mo. Heavy users get clear ROI on the packs. We reserve the right to adjust the included minutes if usage patterns require, with founding members always receiving at least the equivalent of 30 free conversations per month. What if I don't like it? 14-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked. Email support and we refund you in full. Lock in $45 lifetime 14-day money-back guarantee. No questions asked.

## About Digital QR Card | Our Mission for Eco-Friendly Networking

https://www.digitalqrcard.com/about

Welcome to DigitalQRCard Your smart, eco-friendly way to share your business identity. Get Started for Free Our Vision To revolutionize networking by replacing outdated paper business cards with dynamic, editable, and eco-friendly Digital QR Card. Our Mission Empower professionals with an easy-to-use digital business card solution that enhances connections, improves engagement, and saves the environment. Meet the founder I'm Ilyes Tounsi, based in Carlsbad, California. I built Digital QR Card because every time I changed roles, brokerages, or phone numbers, I ended up with a drawer of dead paper cards. The contacts on the cards I'd already handed out couldn't reach the current me. The math kept feeling absurd: a single typo or new title meant another $50 order, and the old stock went straight to the recycling bin. Digital QR Card is the version I wanted to exist. One scan, full profile, updates in seconds, no app required. Paid once at $45 lifetime — no monthly bill, no expiring trial, no upsell pressure. Built specifically for real-estate agents, sales reps, and small-business operators who hand out cards by the hundred and refuse to keep paying for the same problem. I write the code, answer the support emails, and ship the updates myself. Solo operator. Building in public. If something on the site doesn't work, email support@digitalqrcard.com — it reaches me directly, usually within a few hours during the US workday. What this product doesn't do I want to be honest about what you're not buying. Digital QR Card is not a CRM, not a marketing-automation suite, and not a directory. It doesn't auto-post to your social channels or run ad campaigns. It does one job — replace the paper business card with a scannable digital identity — and it does that one job well. If you need a full pipeline tool, this pairs with whatever CRM you already use; it doesn't replace it. — Ilyes, Carlsbad, CA Press, partnerships, or just curious about how this is built? Book a call with me Behind the card What you actually get when you create a Digital QR Card. Three screenshots from the real product, not marketing renders. Your card, on any phone Visitors scan once, get your full profile with one-tap save to contacts, links to every channel that matters, and a vCard download. Scan analytics See how often your card was scanned, when, from what country, on what device. Match a spike in scans to the event you handed cards out at. Team dashboard Crew packs let you invite 3 to 10 team members. Each gets their own card and analytics; optional shared branding across the team. The math of paper cards 7 billion Paper business cards printed worldwide every year. Average professional reprints every 18 to 24 months when their info changes. Most cards are thrown out within the week. A digital card updates in seconds. No reprints. No throw-aways. Your contact info on every card you've ever handed out stays current forever. Source: Wikipedia, pre-COVID global business card production figure. Why Choose DigitalQRCard? Update your card anytime, no reprinting needed. Eco-friendly & sustainable alternative to paper cards. Share with a simple scan or link. Start with a free card Start using DigitalQRCard today and enhance your networking experience. Get Started for Free

## Careers at Digital QR Card — Build the AI operating system for solo founders

https://www.digitalqrcard.com/careers

Careers · Digital QR Card Build the AI operating system for solo founders. We’re small. We ship every week. We use AI to do the work of a team. We’re looking for the first people who want in before this looks obvious. Get on our radar See how we work No open roles right now. But we hire the people we already know before we hire strangers. Why work with us Small team, real ownership One founder today. Every person who joins ships code, copy, or campaigns visible to real users the same week. No layers, no approval chains, no reports up. AI-native, not AI-decorated We build with LLMs in the loop by default — content, code, ops, support. Every workflow gets a 'can an agent do this?' pass before it becomes a job. Async and remote, worldwide No standups. No meetings without an agenda someone actually needs. Voice-first drafting, written follow-ups, work in your own timezone. Weekly ships, transparent numbers You'll see the daily brief. You'll see revenue. You'll see churn. If a bet works, you get credit; if it doesn't, we say so and change course. What we’re building Digital QR Card started as a customizable digital business card and is becoming an AI operating system for solo and small-team founders — a layer of context, data, intelligence, and automation wrapped around a real business so it can run leaner than any competitor. The daily brief that arrives in the founder’s inbox every morning is the first published layer. Voice agents, product demos, content pipelines, and vertical launches (real estate first) are next. The bet is that AI-native teams of one to five can now do what agencies of forty used to. If that’s the kind of company you want to build inside of, we should talk. How we work Weekly ships. Every Friday something goes live — a landing page, a feature, a campaign, a video. If nothing shipped, we broke the week. Voice-first drafting, written follow-through. Talk your first draft, edit it into a doc, commit the doc. Meetings only when a doc can’t do the job. Numbers are open. Revenue, churn, error counts, brief digest — everyone on the team sees the same dashboard the founder sees. Contract-first hiring. We start every relationship as a paid contract engagement (usually 4–12 weeks). If we both want more, we move to a longer commitment with equity in the mix. Async, remote, worldwide. No required overlap hours. Pick the hours that make your life better and deliver against the ship schedule. Open positions None publicly listed right now — here’s what we’ll hire first Content & SEO writer Weekly blog posts + case studies aimed at real estate agents and local service business owners. You write; we ship. Contract-first; equity path if we click. Full-stack engineer (React + Node) Ships product features against the roadmap end-to-end. Comfortable with Mongo, Stripe, PM2 on EC2. Contract-first; equity path if we click. Growth / paid acquisition operator Runs the ad experiments, community outreach, and partnership plays. Reports to numbers, not slides. Contract-first; equity path if we click. Video producer Short-form founder-on-camera + product-demo videos for LinkedIn / YouTube / TikTok. Uses the existing video-auto pipeline. Contract-first. None of these are open positions today. When we do open one, we’ll reach out to the people already on our radar before we post publicly. Get on our radar Send us the short version. No cover letter, no resume unless you want to attach a link to one. We read every message and reply to the ones with something we can click on. Your name Email Role you’d want to play Content & SEO writer Full-stack engineer Growth / paid acquisition Video producer Other Time per week 5 hrs/week 10 hrs/week 20 hrs/week 40 hrs/week (full-time) Link to something you’ve shipped — a repo, a live page, a written piece, a video, a campaign One thing you’d change about digitalqrcard.com in your first week — be specific; this is how we filter Send my application Goes to Ilyes directly. Expect a reply within a week if there’s a spark. “I’m building the kind of company I’d want to work at — small, honest, AI-native, remote, no politics. If any of that sounds like the deal you’ve been looking for, don’t wait for a job to be ‘open.’ The people I remember are the ones who reached out first.” — Ilyes Tounsi, founder

## How to Create a Digital Business Card — Complete Guide

https://www.digitalqrcard.com/card-creation-guide

How to Create a Professional Digital Business Card — Step-by-Step Guide Master the art of creating digital business cards that impress contacts and drive engagement. Complete guide covering design, best practices, psychology, and optimization strategies. Quick Navigation Getting Started: 5 Minutes to Your First Card Essential Information: What to Include Design Tips for Maximum Impact Psychology of Effective Business Cards Optimization & Analytics Distribution Strategies Getting Started: Create Your Card in 5 Minutes Creating a digital business card is simple and requires no technical skills. Here's the fastest path from signup to sharing: 5-Step Quick Start Sign up at DigitalQRCard.com (free, no credit card) Enter basics: name, job title, email, phone number Upload a photo (optional but recommended for professionalism) Select a theme that matches your brand Generate QR code and start sharing immediately That's it! Your card is live and shareable within minutes. You can refine it anytime without affecting existing shares. Create Your Free Card Now Essential Information: What Should Your Card Include? A great digital business card balances completeness with simplicity. Include too little and people can't contact you; include too much and you overwhelm them. Here's the optimal structure: Must-Have ✓ Professional photo ✓ Full name ✓ Job title ✓ Email address ✓ Phone number Highly Recommended 📍 Company/Organization 📍 Website or portfolio 📍 Social media links 📍 Brief bio/summary 📍 Unique value proposition Pro Tips for Each Field Photo: Use a professional headshot (not a selfie). Make sure lighting is good and your expression is warm but professional. This is the first impression — don't skip it. Job Title: Be specific. "Marketing Manager" is better than "Manager." "Growth Marketing Specialist" is even better if that's your focus. Email & Phone: Double-check these are 100% correct. Typos here mean lost opportunities. Bio: 50-100 words is ideal. Explain what you do, who you help, and why it matters. Example: "I help SaaS startups scale their marketing from $1M to $10M ARR. Expertise in growth marketing, product-led acquisition, and team building." Social Links: Only include profiles you actively use. A neglected LinkedIn profile hurts your credibility. Design Tips for Maximum Impact Your digital card's design affects how people perceive you professionally. Here are proven design principles: ✅ Color Psychology Blue: Trust, professionalism (finance, tech, law) Green: Growth, health, sustainability Orange/Red: Energy, creativity (marketing, design) Purple: Creativity, innovation (design, tech) Black/White: Minimalist, professional, luxury ✅ Typography & Layout Choose 2-3 fonts max (avoid chaotic mixing) Ensure text is readable at mobile size Use white space — don't overcrowd Prioritize: photo first, name second, contact third Keep CTA buttons visible above the fold ✅ Theme Selection Match your theme to your industry and personal brand: Corporate/Finance: Minimalist, dark, professional (black, blue, gray) Creative/Design: Bold, colorful, artistic themes that showcase personality Tech/Startup: Modern, clean, tech-forward designs Sales/Networking: Warm, approachable, energetic (orange, warm tones) Consulting: Classic, authoritative, timeless designs The Psychology Behind Effective Digital Cards Understanding why people respond to business cards helps you design one that converts views into connections: 1. First Impression (0.05 seconds) Your photo and color scheme are evaluated instantly. A professional photo builds immediate credibility. A cohesive color scheme signals organization. 2. The Clarity Principle People should immediately understand what you do and why they should care. Avoid jargon and complexity. "Growth hacker" means nothing to most people; "I help startups get their first 1,000 customers" does. 3. The Reciprocity Effect When someone takes time to view your card, make it easy for them to take the next step (call, email, save contact). The one-tap save feature removes friction and increases follow-through. 4. The Authority Principle Link to credible proof: certifications, portfolio, testimonials, social media followers. Don't brag, but let your accomplishments speak. 5. The Likeability Factor A genuine, warm tone and approachable photo make people more likely to connect. You're human — let that shine through in your bio. Optimization: Using Analytics to Improve Your Card Once your card is live, monitor its performance and iterate: Track These Metrics View Count: How many people have viewed your card? Action Rate: What % clicked email, phone, or saved contact? Traffic Sources: Where did views come from (QR scan, link, social)? Device Type: Mostly mobile? Desktop? (Informs design tweaks) Geographic Data: Where are your viewers located? A/B Testing Low action rate? Try these experiments: Refresh your photo (better lighting, more approachable expression) Rewrite your bio to be more compelling and specific Change your theme to match your industry better Add a clear call-to-action in your summary Monitor results over 1-2 weeks before making additional changes. Distribution Strategies: Get Maximum Visibility Creating a great card is half the battle; sharing it strategically is the other half: Where to Share Your Card Digital Channels Email signature LinkedIn profile bio Twitter/X bio Personal website footer Email campaigns Slack/Teams status In-Person & Hybrid Print QR code on physical card Conference booths Event networking Cold outreach emails Business card holder with QR Branding materials Pro Distribution Tips Email Signature: Add your short URL to every email. Everyone you write to can open your card. LinkedIn: Update your bio with a link; it reaches your entire network and appears in search results. Hybrid Cards: Print your QR code on a nice card stock. Hand it out at conferences, meetings. The tactile element + digital convenience is powerful. Social Media: Share your card link and QR code screenshot in posts, stories, and bios. Personal Website: Make your card a central part of your website footer or dedicated "contact" section. Ready to Create Your Professional Digital Card? You now have all the knowledge to create a digital business card that impresses, engages, and converts contacts into meaningful professional relationships. What is a Digital business Card? A Digital business Card is a smart, shareable card that lets you connect, share contact details, or link to your business or profile instantly using a simple QR code. ## Privacy - DigitalQRCard: Crafting Seamless Web Experiences.

https://www.digitalqrcard.com/privacy

Global Privacy Policy for DigitalQRCard Effective Date: November 2, 2026 Governing Language This Privacy Policy is published in multiple languages for your convenience. In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the English version and any translated version, the English version shall prevail and be the binding document. 1. Information We Collect We collect information that identifies, relates to, or could reasonably be linked with you ("Personal Data"). Identifiers: Name, email, IP address, and unique device identifiers. IP addresses are truncated/anonymized so we retain only country or region-level information (not precise location) to comply with privacy regulations. Commercial Information: Transaction history and booking details. Internet Activity: Interaction data within the app and usage statistics. Site assistant: your questions are answered by an AI model from a third-party provider, which receives each question and, when you are signed in, a few facts about your account such as your plan (never your email or payment details). We also keep the questions you type, with email addresses, phone numbers and card numbers removed, for 90 days to improve the answers and, when you are signed in, linked to your account so we can help you. A question about a payment, or about something you paid for not working, may be passed to our team so a person can follow up. Referral links: if you arrive through a friend's referral link, we keep its code in your browser's local storage for up to 30 days so we can give you the friend discount and credit your friend. The code is sent to us when you sign up or buy, and removed once you have bought. If you create an account through a link, we record which account referred you. Clearing your browser's site data removes the code. Celebration greetings: to show a greeting for a celebration where you are, our server looks up your country from your IP address (the full address, not the truncated one used for analytics) in a DB-IP database stored on our own server. The address is not sent to any other service and is not saved for this purpose. We do not do this if you have declined tracking cookies or your browser sends a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal. The country is not saved to a database; your browser keeps it in memory until you reload the page or leave the site, and no cookie or local storage entry is made for the greeting. Your browser may keep the answer in its ordinary cache for up to an hour. If you dismiss a greeting, it stays dismissed until you reload the page or leave the site; if you have accepted cookies, your browser's local storage remembers that for 60 days. Sensitive Data: Account login credentials (encrypted). privacy.nonPersonalizedAdsNote 2. Legal Basis for Processing (EEA, UK, and Switzerland) If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, or Switzerland, we process your data under the following legal bases: Contractual Necessity: To provide the DigitalQRCard services you signed up for. Legitimate Interests: To improve our services, maintain security, and prevent fraud. Consent: Where you have explicitly opted-in (e.g., to receive marketing emails or for non-essential cookies). Legal Obligation: To comply with applicable laws and regulations. 3. Your Global Privacy Rights Regardless of your location, you have rights regarding your data. Residents of California (CCPA/CPRA), Europe (GDPR), Canada (PIPEDA), and Brazil (LGPD) have specific protections: Right Description Access & Portability Request a copy of your data in a machine-readable format. Correction Request that we fix inaccurate or incomplete information. Deletion ("Right to be Forgotten") Request that we erase your personal data, subject to legal limits. Opt-Out of Selling/Sharing Direct us not to share your data for targeted advertising. Withdraw Consent Revoke your consent for data processing at any time. 4. International Data Transfers DigitalQRCard is headquartered in the United States. If you are accessing our services from outside the U.S., your data will be transferred to our servers in the U.S. Safeguards: For users in the EEA and UK, we utilize Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as approved by the European Commission to ensure your data receives the same level of protection it would within your home country. 5. Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information We do not sell your personal data for money. However, we may "share" identifiers with analytics and advertising partners to improve your experience. Global Privacy Control (GPC): Our systems are designed to recognize and honor GPC signals from your browser as a valid request to opt-out of sharing. Manual Opt-Out: You may also opt-out via the "Privacy" menu in your app settings. 6. Data Retention We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in Section 2. When data is no longer required, we either delete it or permanently anonymize it so it cannot be linked back to you. 7. Contact Us To exercise any of your rights or ask a question about this policy: Email: support@digitalqrcard.com Privacy Officer: Data Protection Officer

## Payment and Refund Policy | Digital QR Card

https://www.digitalqrcard.com/subscription-policy

Payment and Refund Policy Digital QR Card is free for two cards. Pro and team packs are paid once: there is no subscription and nothing renews. What you can buy Free: 2 cards, free forever. Pro Lifetime: one payment, at the price shown on the founding member page when you buy, for up to 3 cards and lifetime access to the Pro features. Team packs: 3, 5 or 10 seats, paid once. Each seat gets its own card with the paid features. Payment Payments are processed by Stripe; your card number never reaches our servers. Prices may change for new purchases, but a change never affects what you have already bought. Refunds Pro Lifetime purchases have a 14-day money-back guarantee from the date of purchase. Contact us within 14 days for a full refund; your account then returns to the Free plan. After 14 days, sales are final. Team packs have the same 14-day money-back guarantee from the date of purchase. Older monthly plans The Professional, Premium and Business monthly plans are no longer sold. If you still have one, it renews each month until you cancel it in Profile &gt; Subscription. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and the current period is not refunded. Questions about a payment? Reach us through the Contact page.
